meta.product: Public Cap coach free-agent / offset desk
meta.scope: Fired Power 4 football head coaches still carrying a cited residual buyout. School A residual and offset rules are booked / cite-only. School B salary may be a labeled modeled input.
meta.notes: Sibling to the current-chair /buyout calculator. A-side dollars stay empty without a cite. We do not invent today's remaining principal, and we do not invent an offset credit when the file says none. Optional all-in is A residual + B salary — two payers, off by default.
sources: Marquette Law School / GCC — Mitigation Clauses in College Football (quotes the Dec. 4, 2017 Texas A&M / Fisher EA ¶5.3 no-offset language and the remaining-buyout figure used by CBS / The Athletic)
USA TODAY (Aug. 22, 2018) — Fisher $75M Texas A&M deal: school gets no help if it fires him without cause
CBS Sports — Fisher buyout: Texas A&M paying the dismissed coach through 2031; $77,562,500 remaining at termination, 25% lump + eight annuals
ESPN — Texas A&M fired Jimbo Fisher without cause on Nov. 12, 2023
